agents.challenge: Existence, target-root uniqueness under clipping plateaus, parameter continuity and original path endpoints
agents.result: Passed. Global strict monotonicity is false at saturated plateaus; distinct roots at h force equal continuous clipped controls, then constant saturation, impossible since ±z(T) != h. Compact-root continuity and zero endpoint biases valid.

agents.challenge: Path connectedness to exact full D image and time branches
agents.result: Passed. Exact endpoint-preserving path plus continuous cost and C042 sharp sequences gives every interior D by IVT. T=tmin singleton, T<tmin empty.
